purpose: The full-bleed decorative band that separates two sections.
geometry: band w-[120em] -mt-[3em], h-[15em] at z-[200]; 2px black rule at z-[201]; total 161.98px @1280
containerNote: Does NOT use the standard max-w-[1920px] px-[6em] container — the 120em band is mx-auto directly inside the section, so at 1280 it spans the full viewport. Adding the gutter wrapper would push it into horizontal overflow.

bandColour.RULE: THE BAND COLOUR FOLLOWS THE SECTION ABOVE IT. It is not a fixed default; it is a per-instance decision set by the `band` prop. cream on the homepage, cream-dark after a dark section, bg-leaf after /our-purpose's Goals band.

states: No hover, no active, no focus, no transition, no box-shadow.
